description: Limitation pin (016 T014p, plan D11 as amended after round 7; round-6 review F2, q01). A div tag line closes a script and opens another, so the browser stays inside the second script past the blank line, and the hidden rule's marker is inside it. The reading does not model the reopen: the end tag on the line closes the element, so the marker is harvested and the digest that carries only the visible rule is read as stale. What hides the marker is a script, not a comment, which FR-003 allows. If the reopen is ever modelled, the digest check passes, so this case fails and must be retired or turned into a guard.
